shopping_stage.instructions: Where is this visitor in their shopping journey right now, on an online merchandise store?

criteria.browsing: Looking around without a specific product in mind: mostly home and category pages, few or no product pages, nothing in the cart.
criteria.researching: Considering specific products: several product pages, coming back to similar items, but nothing added to the cart yet.
criteria.ready_to_buy: Clear intent to purchase: items added to the cart, visits to the cart or sign-in pages, attention narrowed to a few products.
criteria.stuck: Having trouble: repeated searches, going back and forth between the same pages, or hitting account pages without making progress.

will_purchase.instructions: Will this visitor complete a purchase later in this same session?

criteria.true: The visitor goes on to place an order before the session ends.
criteria.false: The session ends without an order.
